goal: 100 additional heavy v2 high-quality One Life Relay stages
notes: Each stage has two coupled systems. No Simon-says tap-the-glow clones. 46-52s.

stages.title: 증기 언덕
stages.description: 화실과 수위를 같이 맞춰 증기기관차를 언덕 너머로 넘기세요.
stages.controls: 드래그로 스로틀, 탭으로 석탄, 홀드로 급수
stages.mechanic: Cab view of a steam loco. Coupled systems: firebox heat vs boiler water. Throttle climbs grades but drops pressure; inject water without drowning the fire. Safety valve blow = fail, stall on grade = fail. Three successive grades with tunnels. Distinct from boiler-band (no sequence of target bands) and mill-wheel. Camera in the cab looking down the boiler and track.

stages.title: 회전 가마
stages.description: 기울기와 연료를 맞춰 클링커를 태워 내세요.
stages.mechanic: Long rotating cement kiln. Coupled: pitch angle vs fuel. Too steep rushes raw meal (uncooked), too much fuel melts lining. Clinker nodules must glow then drop to cooler. Distinct from kiln-orbit (pot glaze, not kiln tube) and forge-strike. Side-along industrial camera with heat haze.

stages.title: 말뚝 박기
stages.description: 바지선이 흔들리는 동안 드롭해머로 말뚝을 박으세요.
stages.controls: 드래그로 바지선 위치, 탭으로 해머 낙하시
stages.mechanic: Barge-mounted drop hammer in a tidal river. Coupled: barge drift vs drop timing. Tide and wakes shift the barge; counter-thrust before each drop. Miss the pile cap or list past 12° fails. Distinct from quarry-block (no drop hammer) and meteor-anvil. Camera on the hammer leads looking down at the pile.

stages.title: 도개교
stages.description: 배를 보내고 마차를 건네려면 도개교 무게추를 맞춰 여닫으세요.
stages.controls: 홀드로 상승, 떼면 하강, 탭으로 잠금
stages.mechanic: Bascule bridge over a canal. Coupled: counterweight vs traffic timing. Ships approach with horns (telegraph 1.4s). Carts wait on the deck. Raise for ships, lock down for carts. Unbalanced raise slams the leaf. Distinct from canal-lock (no pumping) and bridge-build. Camera on the leaf looking both ways.

stages.title: 곡식 사일로
stages.description: 엘리베이터와 슈트를 바꿔 세 사일로를 고르게 채우세요.
stages.mechanic: Country elevator. Coupled: bucket-belt speed vs chute divert. Three silos must stay within 15% of each other. Overflow dust explosion telegraph then fail. Starving the belt jams. Distinct from mill-stone, mill-wheel, grain metaphors. Camera on the headhouse looking at the three bins.

stages.title: 유정 굴착
stages.description: 비트 하중과 이수 펌프를 맞춰 유정까지 뚫으세요.
stages.mechanic: Rotary table on a wooden derrick. Coupled: weight-on-bit vs mud flow. Too much WOB sticks the string, too little bores blind, mud too low kicks then blows. Distinct from ice-core-drill (no mud, no kick). Camera on the floor looking up the mast and down the hole.

stages.title: 활판 인쇄
stages.description: 두 색 판을 맞춰 돌리는 동안 정합을 유지하세요.
stages.mechanic: Two-color cylinder press. Coupled: plate register vs cycle speed. Nudge cyan plate while the press runs; feed paper on the gripper window. Misregister > 2mm or a jam fails. Distinct from rune-stamp (no conveyor stamps) and loom-shuttle. Close workshop camera on the cylinders.

stages.title: 용광로 장입
stages.description: 코크스·광석·플럭스를 켜켜이 넣고 송풍을 유지하세요.
stages.mechanic: NOT forge-strike and NOT iron-quench. Charge skip hoist: coke/ore/flux layers must stay in ratio while tuyere blast holds a heat band. Tapping the iron is a hold-window. Distinct from bellows-heart. Camera on the skip and tuyere platform.

stages.title: 소모 기계
stages.description: 드럼 속도와 급모를 맞춰 실타래를 뽑으세요.
stages.controls: 드래그로 드럼 속도, 탭으로 원모 투입
stages.mechanic: NOT mill-wheel/mill-stone. A carding drum with worker/stripper rollers. Feed wool when the hopper is hungry; match drum speed to feed. Overfeed nests, overspeed snaps sliver. Camera close on the cylinder with flying fibers.

stages.title: 수차 터빈
stages.description: 수문과 부하를 맞춰 발전기 회전수를 지키세요.
stages.mechanic: Penstock and Francis turbine. Coupled: wicket-gate opening vs electrical load. Demand steps up/down; keep RPM in a green band. Overspeed trips, stall blackouts. Distinct from canal-lock and mill-wheel. Camera in the spiral case looking at the runner.

stages.title: 쇄빙선
stages.description: 속도와 선수로 얼음을 깨며 항로를 여세요.
stages.controls: 드래그로 조타, 홀드로 가속, 탭으로 후진
stages.clearCondition: 결빙 항로 끝 부표에 도착하면 클리어
stages.mechanic: NOT frost-skiff (no sail) and NOT rift-skater. Ram ice at speed, reverse off the ridge, then ram again. Heading vs momentum. Get stuck in pressure ice = fail. Camera high behind the bow looking at the ice field.

stages.title: 예인 접안
stages.description: 조류를 이기고 예인선으로 화물선을 부두에 붙이세요.
stages.mechanic: Tug pushing a freighter's quarter. Coupled: current set vs vector thrust. Fenders compress; impact > threshold fails. Distinct from canal-lock (no water-level matching) and storm-anchor. Camera from a harbor tower.

stages.title: 소방정
stages.description: 모니터 각과 펌프 압력으로 창고 화재를 잡으세요.
stages.mechanic: Two deck monitors. Coupled: aim vs pump pressure. Too much pressure bursts a hose, too little the fire jumps to the next bay (telegraph glow). Distinct from thunder-rod. Camera on the bow looking at the warehouse.

stages.title: 저인망
stages.description: 그물 깊이를 바닥에서 떼고 가득 차면 양망하세요.
stages.mechanic: NOT reef-sub, NOT comet-net. Otter doors and a headline. Keep the footrope just off a rocky seafloor (sonar returns). Fill the codend then haul; snag = fail. Camera underwater beside the net and on deck for the haul.

stages.title: 삿대 곤돌라
stages.description: 삿대로 밀고 몸을 기대 운하 모퉁이를 돌리세요.
stages.mechanic: NOT magma-gondola. Stand on the poppa, plant a pole, push, recover. Coupled: pole vector vs stance balance. Tight corners, other boats. Distinct from lantern-drift (no gate routing). Camera behind the gondolier.

stages.title: 자기부상 분기
stages.description: 속도와 가이드웨이를 맞춰 분기 선로를 타세요.
stages.mechanic: NOT quartz-tram (minecart tap). Maglev has inertia; you must be in a speed window when the guideway switch throws. Upcoming junction highlighted 1.6s out. Distinct from vine-switch. Chase camera along a neon guideway.

stages.title: 대상 밧줄
stages.description: 낙타 줄의 장력과 오아시스 물을 지키며 사막을 건너세요.
stages.mechanic: NOT ox-cart, NOT dune-skimmer. A string of 5 camels on one rope. Tight turns spike tension (snap), loose lets a camel wander into a sink. Water at oases. Camera beside the lead camel looking back along the string.

stages.title: 루지 라인
stages.description: 기울기와 브레이크로 게이트를 정확히 통과하세요.
stages.mechanic: NOT avalanche-sled (no tree dodge). Drive a racing line through iced gates. Coupled: lean vs drag brake. Too much speed misses the late gate, too much brake loses the wall. Camera just behind the sled looking into the channel.

stages.title: 스컬 캐치
stages.description: 좌우 노의 캐치를 맞춰 부표를 통과하세요.
stages.mechanic: Single scull. Coupled: port vs starboard catch timing. Uneven drive yaws the shell; a late extract crabs (fail). Buoy gates. Distinct from frost-skiff. Camera from a following launch, low over water.

stages.title: 비행선 밸러스트
stages.description: 밸러스트와 밸브를 맞춰 탑 링을 통과하세요.
stages.mechanic: NOT reef-sub, NOT solstice-glider, NOT whale-blow. Gas valves vs sand ballast vs elevator. Dynamic trim. Rings hang between spires in wind. Camera behind the gondola along the hull.

stages.title: 쐐기돌
stages.description: 아치 돌을 올리고 쐐기돌을 넣은 뒤 동바리를 빼세요.
stages.controls: 드래그로 돌 안착, 홀드로 동바리 해체
stages.mechanic: Centering under a stone arch. Place voussoirs left-right to keep thrust even, drop the keystone, then ease the wooden centering. Uneven thrust collapses. Distinct from tomb-seal and quarry-block. Camera on the centering looking up into the arch.

stages.title: 목구조 기립
stages.description: 긴 장대로 벤트를 세우고 수직을 맞춘 뒤 핀을 치세요.
stages.mechanic: Barn raising. Coupled: gin-pole haul vs plumb. Two ropes; if one outruns the other the bent twists and falls. Pin when the spirit level is green. Distinct from pulley-cliff. Camera at ground looking up the bent.

stages.title: 코퍼댐
stages.description: 샘을 막으며 물을 퍼내고 밑창을 봉하세요.
stages.clearCondition: 밑창 봉인 후 바닥이 드러나면 클리어
stages.mechanic: Inside a river cofferdam. Coupled: leak patches vs pump capacity. New leaks telegraph as dark stains. Distinct from canal-lock and rain-cistern. Camera down in the pit with the river wall above.

stages.title: 이엉 지붕
stages.description: 바람에 맞서 이엉을 겹치고 용마루를 묶으세요.
stages.mechanic: Roof slope in weather. Coupled: layer overlap vs gust timing. Hold to wait out a gust then bind. Exposed edge strips. Distinct from silk-span. Camera on the roof looking along the ridge.

stages.title: 비계 수직
stages.description: 흔들리는 비계를 수직으로 쌓고 올라가 처마에 닿으세요.
stages.mechanic: NOT spiral-ascent, NOT chimney-brush. Build frames, climb, wind sways the tower (plumb bob). Tie in before the lean exceeds a mark. Distinct from hourglass-climb. Camera slightly below looking up the facade.

stages.title: 현수 케이블
stages.description: 양쪽 장력을 맞춰 주케이블 처짐을 목표 곡선에 넣으세요.
stages.mechanic: NOT silk-span (no gust strand to opposite cliff). Spin a main cable between two towers. Coupled winches; sag must match a ghost catenary. Uneven tension leans a tower. Camera from mid-span looking at both towers.

stages.title: 나선 벽돌
stages.description: 나선형 볼트를 쌓되 본드와 수직을 동시에 지키세요.
stages.mechanic: NOT spiral-ascent (no rotating stairs). Lay a helical brick vault. Coupled: bond pattern vs plumb. A missed header opens a crack that grows. Camera inside the rising helix.

stages.title: 스테인드 캠
stages.description: 유리 조각을 납 캠에 끼우고 땜이 식기 전에 맞추세요.
stages.mechanic: NOT glass-arrow, NOT frost-pane. Lead came channels + glass pieces + solder heat window. Overheat cracks glass, cold solder lifts. Close-up on the bench with the rose window ghost.

stages.title: 마차길 포석
stages.description: 왕관 경사에 맞춰 돌을 놓고 물로 배수를 확인하세요.
stages.controls: 드래그로 돌 배치, 홀드로 물 시험
stages.mechanic: NOT tessera-fall (no catching tiles), NOT quarry-block. Set cobbles to a crowned camber. Water test reveals puddles (must re-seat). Distinct from rune-stamp. Camera along the street at knee height.

stages.title: 판축
stages.description: 거푸집에 흙을 넣고 다진 뒤 거푸집을 벗겨 벽을 세우세요.
stages.controls: 탭으로 흙 투입, 홀드로 다지기, 드래그로 거푸집
stages.failCondition: 너무 젖어 무너지거나 너무 말라 부스러지면 실패
stages.mechanic: Formwork, lift, ram, strip. Coupled: moisture vs compaction energy. Distinct from amber-press. Camera on the form looking at the lift lines.

stages.title: 고가사다리
stages.description: 바람에 맞서 사다리를 올리고 창문의 사람을 태우세요.
stages.mechanic: Tillered aerial on a burning facade. Coupled: wind drift vs stick length. Person appears at a window with a telegraph wave. Overextend in wind fails the stick. Camera from the turntable looking up.

stages.title: 모래주머니
stages.description: 물이 오르는 동안 둑을 쌓고 샘을 막으세요.
stages.controls: 드래그로 포대 쌓기, 탭으로 누수 막기
stages.mechanic: NOT stair-tide, NOT rain-cistern. Stack a sandbag levee while the river rises. Seep stains telegraph; plug them. Distinct from coffer-pump (that's inside a dam). Camera along the levee.

stages.title: 활선 작업
stages.description: 절연 거리를 지키며 점퍼로 전선을 다시 잇으세요.
stages.mechanic: Lineman in a bucket. Coupled: stick angle vs clearance envelope (glow when close). Arc telegraph. Distinct from spark-fuse and thunder-rod. Camera over the shoulder toward the crossarm.

stages.title: 연기 크롤
stages.description: 열기층 아래로 기어 요구조자를 찾고 나오세요.
stages.failCondition: 직상 열기에 노출되거나 길을 잃으면 실패
stages.mechanic: NOT chimney-brush, NOT smoke-beacon. Stay below the hot layer (heat meter). Search pattern on a floorplan, victim groans telegraph. Distinct from echo-sonar. Camera low, smoky interior.

stages.title: 빙판 구조
stages.description: 사다리로 접근해 슬링을 던지고 빙판이 깨지기 전에 끌어내세요.
stages.controls: 드래그로 접근, 탭으로 슬링, 홀드로 견인
stages.mechanic: NOT frost-skiff, NOT rift-skater. Crack network grows with time/weight. Coupled: approach distance vs haul. Distinct from well-bucket. Camera across the ice toward the hole.

stages.title: 갱도 환기
stages.description: 팬을 뒤집어 가스를 빼고 고립된 팀에 닿으세요.
stages.mechanic: NOT quartz-tram. Reverse fans and open brattices to keep methane below a red band while you walk in. Distinct from echo-sonar. Headlamp camera in timbered drift.

stages.title: 확보 강하
stages.description: 낙석을 피하며 부상자를 로프로 내려보내세요.
stages.controls: 홀드로 제동, 탭으로 낙석 경고 정지
stages.mechanic: NOT pendulum-spire (no clocktower rappel race), NOT pulley-cliff. Belayer on a ledge. Coupled: brake hand vs rockfall pauses. Distinct from moss-climb. Camera from the belay looking down the face.

stages.title: 옥내 호스
stages.description: 꺾임을 풀고 주수로 화실을 제압하세요.
stages.controls: 드래그로 전진, 탭으로 꺾임 해소, 홀드로 주수
stages.failCondition: 꺾임으로 압이 죽거나 플래시오버가 나면 실패
stages.mechanic: NOT fire-monitor (not a boat). Advance a charged line down a hall. Coupled: kinks vs nozzle. Ceiling gases telegraph flashover. Camera behind the nozzle team.

stages.title: 탐침 수색
stages.description: 비콘 방향과 탐침 격자로 매몰자를 찾으세요.
stages.mechanic: NOT avalanche-sled. Beacon tone + directional LED, then probe grid. Coupled: search path vs remaining air time. Distinct from ley-compass. Camera on the debris field.

stages.title: 잠수종
stages.description: 공기 호스가 걸리지 않게 종을 내려 유물을 건지세요.
stages.controls: 위아래로 깊이, 좌우로 종 이동, 홀드로 집어 올리기
stages.failCondition: 호스가 끊기거나 종에 물이 차면 실패
stages.mechanic: NOT pearl-lung (no free dive breath), NOT kraken-well, NOT reef-sub. Bell with an air hose that snags on wreckage. Coupled: hose slack vs depth. Camera outside the bell in green water.

stages.title: 코끼리 견재
stages.description: 코끼리가 끄는 통나무가 캠프를 치지 않게 몰으세요.
stages.mechanic: Mahout on the neck. Coupled: turn radius vs log swing. The log occupies a wide rear envelope. Distinct from ox-cart and wheel-barrow. Camera behind looking at the log.

stages.title: 양몰이
stages.description: 좌우 개 위치를 바꿔 양 떼를 우리에 넣으세요.
stages.controls: 좌우 드래그로 개 위치, 탭으로 앉기
stages.mechanic: NOT goat-ledge, NOT cloud-scoop, NOT constellation-herd, NOT koi-gate. Two-flank herding: pressure vs gap. Split flock fails. Camera elevated over the paddock.

stages.title: 비버 댐
stages.description: 흐름에 맞춰 가지를 끼워 댐 샘을 막으세요.
stages.controls: 드래그로 가지 배치, 탭으로 진흙 메우기
stages.mechanic: NOT dam-gate v1. Place sticks into current (they drift if not wedged), then mud the leaks. Distinct from coffer-pump. Camera at water level on the dam face.

stages.title: 연어 어도
stages.description: 수문 타이밍으로 연어를 어도 위로 올리세요.
stages.mechanic: NOT koi-gate (you do not swim). Operate weir gates and clear debris so salmon can jump pools. Coupled: flow vs jump windows. Camera beside the ladder.

stages.title: 실켜기
stages.description: 온도와 속도로 고치를 풀어 실이 끊기지 않게 하세요.
stages.controls: 드래그로 릴 속도, 홀드로 탕 온도
stages.mechanic: NOT silk-span, NOT copper-helix, NOT loom-shuttle. Basin temperature vs reel speed vs filament join. Distinct from nest-twig. Close-up of cocoons, basin, and swifts.

stages.title: 전서구
stages.description: 매를 피해 전서구를 지붕 출입구로 들이세요.
stages.mechanic: NOT raven-mail (no letter toss), NOT owl-silent, NOT falcon-dive. Steer a loft lure and time the trapdoor. Hawks stoop with telegraph shadows. Camera above the village looking at the loft.

stages.title: 편자
stages.description: 발굽 각을 잡고 못이 살을 찌르지 않게 편자를 박으세요.
stages.failCondition: 못이 살을 찌르거나 말이 빼면 실패
stages.mechanic: Hold the hoof (angle meter), seat the shoe, nail in a safe zone. Horse pulls if you linger. Distinct from forge-strike. Close-up under the belly looking at the hoof.

stages.title: 우유 멍에
stages.description: 젖을 짜고 멍에로 나르되 넘치지 않게 걸으세요.
stages.mechanic: NOT ox-cart, NOT lantern-oil. Sit and milk (fill meter), then walk a shoulder yoke. Coupled: slosh vs step rhythm. Camera follows from the stall to the dairy.

stages.title: 문어 항아리
stages.description: 조류 속에 항아리를 내리고 미끼를 지키세요.
stages.controls: 드래그로 항아리 투하, 탭으로 미끼 회수
stages.failCondition: 미끼를 모두 잃거나 배가 기울면 실패
stages.mechanic: NOT pearl-lung. Skiff on a current. Lower pots onto a shelf, octopus investigates, steal bait if you linger. Distinct from crab-pot. Camera over the gunwale into the water.

stages.title: 산호 이식
stages.description: 조류에 조각을 고정하고 빛이 세면 가리세요.
stages.mechanic: NOT coral-choir (no pitch matching), NOT kelp-gate. Place fragments in current, pin them, shade if light spikes (bleach meter). Camera on the reef shelf.

stages.title: 부교
stages.description: 흐름 속에 부함을 잇고 핀을 박아 부교를 완성하세요.
stages.mechanic: NOT canal-lock. Float pontoons in current, pin them, deck. Coupled: drift vs pin window. Camera from the near bank.

stages.title: 빙판 톱
stages.description: 얼음 블록을 켜서 띄우고 물에 빠지지 않게 끌어내세요.
stages.mechanic: NOT glacier-wire (no heated wire), NOT ice-core-drill. Score, saw, float, hook. Coupled: cut pattern vs crack spread. Camera on the ice field with the open water.

stages.title: 그물 수선
stages.description: 흔들리는 갑판에서 그물코를 북으로 꿰매세요.
stages.failCondition: 코가 더 찢어지거나 북을 떨어뜨리면 실패
stages.mechanic: NOT comet-net, NOT spider-silk. Deck pitch shifts the mesh. Coupled: needle path vs roll. Distinct from loom-shuttle. Close-up of mesh against the sea.

stages.title: 다시마 채취
stages.description: 배 위치와 낫 깊이로 다시마를 베어 올리세요.
stages.mechanic: NOT kelp-gate (no swimming through slamming gates). Work from a dory. Coupled: boat station vs sickle depth. Camera between hull and kelp forest.

stages.title: 굴 집게
stages.description: 집게 깊이와 배 기울기를 맞춰 굴을 집어 올리세요.
stages.mechanic: NOT pearl-lung. Long tongs from a skiff. Coupled: tong depth vs heel. Distinct from well-bucket. Camera from the thwart looking overboard.

stages.title: 사금 수로
stages.description: 물 흐름과 단을 맞춰 금만 남기고 모래를 흘리세요.
stages.failCondition: 금이 쓸려 가거나 수로가 막히면 실패
stages.mechanic: NOT sieve-gem, NOT gold-pan v1, NOT salt-grow. A long tom. Coupled: water flow vs riffle angle. Too much water loses gold, too little packs sand. Camera along the sluice.

stages.title: 침선 부표
stages.description: 너울 속에서 침선에 줄을 걸고 부표를 세우세요.
stages.controls: 드래그로 소형 보트, 홀드로 줄 투하
stages.failCondition: 줄이 끊기거나 보트에 물이 차면 실패
stages.mechanic: NOT fog-buoy (no horn/fog), NOT storm-anchor. Work a dinghy in swell over a wreck. Coupled: line taut vs buoy position. Camera from a following wave.

stages.title: 게 통발
stages.description: 통발을 놓고 줄을 감아 올리되 암초에 걸리지 않게 하세요.
stages.controls: 탭으로 투하, 홀드로 양망, 드래그로 선위
stages.mechanic: NOT octopus-pot (different animal/camera). Buoy line + pot + prop hazard. Coupled: haul speed vs boat drift. Camera on deck and briefly underwater on the pot.

stages.title: 돛 줄여 묶기
stages.description: 바람이 세지는 동안 리프 포인트를 묶어 돛을 줄이세요.
stages.mechanic: NOT frost-skiff (not tacking buoys), NOT windmill-set. On a heeling deck, gather sail and tie reef points in order. Coupled: heel vs lashing window. Camera on the boom.

stages.title: 캡스턴 워프
stages.description: 캡스턴을 밟아 배를 바람받이에서 빼내세요.
stages.mechanic: NOT storm-anchor (no aiming reef rings), NOT pulley-cliff. Walk the capstan, pawl, surge. Coupled: cadence vs line tension as the hull comes off a lee shore. Camera on deck around the capstan.

stages.title: 망원 추적
stages.description: 적경·적위로 혜성을 추적하며 구름 사이를 찍으세요.
stages.mechanic: NOT ion-sling, NOT ley-compass. Equatorial mount with periodic error. Coupled: tracking vs cloud windows. Dome slit. Camera in the dome looking along the tube.

stages.title: 적정
stages.description: 플라스크를 흔들며 종말점 색에 맞춰 한 방울씩 떨어뜨리세요.
stages.mechanic: Lab bench close-up. Coupled: drop rate vs swirl mixing. Color walks toward magenta; overshoot fails. Distinct from potion-pour v1. Camera on flask and burette.

stages.title: 원심분리
stages.description: 튜브를 대칭으로 넣고 진동 없이 회전을 올리세요.
stages.mechanic: Four-place rotor. Coupled: mass layout vs ramp. Walks off the bench if unbalanced. Lid interlock. Close-up lab camera.

stages.title: 진공종
stages.description: 유리종이 깨지지 않게 진공을 뽑고 시료를 말리세요.
stages.mechanic: Bell jar and rotary pump. Coupled: pump-down rate vs glass stress (thin samples). Too fast crazes the jar. Distinct from airlock-cycle. Bench camera.

stages.title: 분광 슬릿
stages.description: 슬릿과 프리즘을 맞춰 스펙트럼 선을 읽으세요.
stages.mechanic: NOT prism-bounce (no combat laser maze). Coupled: slit width vs prism angle vs lamp drift. Dark lab. Camera on the optical bench.

stages.title: 지진계
stages.description: 북이 흔들리는 동안 펜을 종이에 붙이고 시계를 감으세요.
stages.mechanic: Drum, stylus, ink, clockwork. Coupled: contact force vs drum speed during a quake. Distinct from ley-compass. Close-up of the vault instrument.

stages.title: 기상 존데
stages.description: 풍선 부력과 밸러스트로 목표 고도의 층을 지나세요.
stages.mechanic: NOT airship-ballast (no rings), NOT whale-blow. Coupled: lift vs icing vs burst. Layer clouds. Camera following the balloon up.

stages.title: 전파 접시
stages.description: 접시를 위성 패스에 맞추고 풍속에 따라 스토우하세요.
stages.mechanic: NOT telescope-slew (optical dome). Desert dish. Coupled: tracking vs wind stow limit. Camera at the pedestal looking at the dish and sky.

stages.title: 궤도 모형
stages.description: 행성 기어를 날짜에 맞춰 맞물리고 식 시각을 맞추세요.
stages.mechanic: NOT gear-mesh (no launching gears onto shafts), NOT clock-ride. Nested planet gears, clutch to a date ring. Coupled: mesh vs date. Camera on the brass orrery.

stages.title: 안개상자
stages.description: 팽창과 온도를 맞춰 입자 궤적을 찍으세요.
stages.controls: 홀드로 팽창, 드래그로 냉각, 탭으로 촬영
stages.mechanic: Wilson chamber. Coupled: expansion ratio vs alcohol temperature. Tracks appear in a short window. Close-up of the chamber.

stages.title: 증류 컷
stages.description: 온도 밴드를 지키며 헤드·하트·테일을 가르세요.
stages.clearCondition: 하트만 받아 한 배치를 마치면 클리어
stages.mechanic: NOT boiler-band (no 4-valve band sequence). Spirit still. Coupled: heat vs cut timing (heads/hearts/tails). Distinct from coffee-dripper. Camera on the lyne arm and spirit safe.

stages.title: 탄두르
stages.description: 벽을 달군 뒤 난을 붙이고 타기 전에 떼세요.
stages.mechanic: Look down a clay tandoor. Coupled: wall temperature vs slap/peel window. Distinct from forge-strike. Camera into the mouth of the oven.

stages.title: 에스프레소
stages.description: 탬핑과 압력 밴드로 추출을 멈추는 타이밍을 맞추세요.
stages.mechanic: NOT coffee-dripper v1. Coupled: tamp evenness vs 9-bar band vs blonding stop. Close-up of group head and cup.

stages.title: 쪽물
stages.description: 담갔다가 공기 중에서 청으로 산화시킨 뒤 다시 담그세요.
stages.mechanic: Vat is greenish; air turns it blue. Coupled: dip time vs air oxidation. Distinct from color-alchemist v1. Courtyard camera on the vat.

stages.title: 옻칠
stages.description: 얇게 칠하고 먼지를 막고 지촉 건조 후 다음 켜를 올리세요.
stages.failCondition: 먼지가 박히거나 너무 두꺼워 주름지면 실패
stages.mechanic: NOT amber-press, NOT resin-catch. Coupled: film thickness vs dust vs tack window. Quiet room camera on the tray.

stages.title: 청자 빙렬
stages.description: 냉각 속도로 빙렬을 만들고 유약이 박이지 않게 하세요.
stages.mechanic: NOT kiln-orbit (no spinning pot glaze), NOT star-mold. Coupled: cool rate vs crackle. Distinct from iron-quench. Camera in the kiln door.

stages.title: 다마스커스
stages.description: 접고 늘이며 스케일을 털고 층수를 맞추세요.
stages.controls: 홀드로 가열, 탭으로 접기, 드래그로 늘리기
stages.mechanic: NOT forge-strike (no color-window hammer only), NOT iron-quench. Fold/draw/brush scale. Coupled: heat vs weld. Camera on the anvil.

stages.title: 다다미 선
stages.description: 골풀을 두드리고 선을 두르며 직각을 지키세요.
stages.mechanic: Workshop floor. Coupled: beat compaction vs edge binding vs square. Distinct from nest-twig. Camera on the mat.

stages.title: 창호지
stages.description: 격자에 한지를 붙이되 주름과 찢김이 없게 하세요.
stages.mechanic: NOT frost-pane (no frost tracing). Coupled: paste wetness vs stretch. Shoji lattice. Close-up camera.

stages.title: 먹갈기
stages.description: 물과 갈기 속도로 점도를 맞춰 한 획을 완성하세요.
stages.clearCondition: 목표 점도의 먹을 만들어 한 자를 쓰면 클리어
stages.mechanic: NOT incense-coil. Coupled: water vs grinding circles vs a final brush stroke on paper. Distinct from frost-pane. Desk camera.

stages.title: 장대높이뛰기
stages.description: 도움닫기 속도와 꽂기 각으로 바를 넘으세요.
stages.controls: 홀드로 가속, 탭으로 꽂기, 드래그로 회전
stages.mechanic: Runway, plant box, invert, bar. Coupled: speed vs plant angle vs pull. Distinct from pendulum-spire. Camera from the side of the pit.

stages.title: 해머던지기
stages.description: 회전 수를 쌓고 섹터 안으로 릴리스하세요.
stages.mechanic: Circle and cage. Coupled: rotation count vs release window vs balance. Distinct from atlas-sphere. Camera high above the circle.

stages.title: 창던지기
stages.description: 크로스오버 후 블록 다리로 창을 던지세요.
stages.controls: 홀드로 도움닫기, 탭으로 블록, 드래그로 릴리스 각
stages.mechanic: NOT glass-arrow (no wind cathedral archery). Coupled: approach vs block vs release. Camera beside the runway.

stages.title: 스프링보드
stages.description: 허들 스텝으로 판을 누르고 수직 입수하세요.
stages.controls: 탭으로 허들, 홀드로 보드, 드래그로 자세
stages.mechanic: 3m board. Coupled: hurdle timing vs board depression vs entry angle. Splash fail. Camera from the side of the pool.

stages.title: 케이린
stages.description: 페이서 뒤에서 드래프트하다 마지막 바퀴에 스프린트하세요.
stages.mechanic: Velodrome. Coupled: draft pocket vs sprint timing vs overlap. Distinct from quartz-tram. Camera above the banking.

stages.title: 카누 슬라롬
stages.description: 상류 게이트를 포함해 흐르는 물에서 게이트를 통과하세요.
stages.mechanic: NOT frost-skiff, NOT canal-lock. Upstream gates require ferry angles. Coupled: paddle vs brace in features. Camera from a bank-side boom.

stages.title: 세단뛰기
stages.description: 홉·스텝·점프 보드를 순서대로 밟으세요.
stages.mechanic: Coupled: approach speed vs hop/step/jump rhythm. Distinct from lily-hop. Camera from the side of the runway.

stages.title: 펜싱 렁지
stages.description: 거리를 잡고 비트 후 연장으로 유효면을 찌르세요.
stages.controls: 드래그로 거리, 탭으로 비트, 홀드로 렁지
stages.mechanic: NOT pulse-fencing v1 community stages. Coupled: measure vs beat vs extension. Piste camera.

stages.title: 포환던지기
stages.description: 글라이드로 중심을 옮기고 토보드 안에서 던지세요.
stages.mechanic: Circle. Coupled: glide vs reverse vs toe board. Distinct from hammer-spin. Camera at circle height.

stages.title: 스키점프
stages.description: 인런에서 자세를 낮추고 테이크오프 후 텔레마크로 착지하세요.
stages.controls: 홀드로 자세, 탭으로 도약, 드래그로 착지
stages.mechanic: NOT avalanche-sled, NOT solstice-glider. Coupled: inrun tuck vs takeoff timing vs telemark. Camera from a following drone.

stages.title: 용암 동굴
stages.description: 로버 기울기와 열을 관리하며 관을 통과하세요.
stages.mechanic: NOT ember-raft (no river), NOT magma-skip. Coupled: pitch/roll vs thermal soak. Skylights. Camera behind the rover.

stages.title: 에어록
stages.description: 두 해치를 연동해 압력을 맞추고 잔해를 빼세요.
stages.controls: 탭으로 해치, 홀드로 펌프, 드래그로 잔해
stages.failCondition: 해치가 동시에 열리거나 폭발 감압되면 실패
stages.mechanic: NOT vacuum-jar. Interlock logic: never both hatches. Coupled: pump-down vs debris jam. Interior camera.

stages.title: 계류 보행
stages.description: 테더가 안테나에 감기지 않게 EVA로 패널을 교체하세요.
stages.controls: 드래그로 이동, 홀드로 핸드레일, 탭으로 훅
stages.mechanic: NOT spider-silk, NOT gyro-keep. Coupled: handrail path vs tether slack around an antenna. Camera slightly off the hull.

stages.title: 태양돛
stages.description: 광자 각을 맞춰 잔해를 피하며 도킹 링으로 가세요.
stages.mechanic: NOT frost-skiff, NOT ribbon-kite. Coupled: sun angle vs debris field. Slow but inertial. Camera looking along the sail vanes.

stages.title: 용오름
stages.description: 용오름 가장자리를 타고 상승하되 핵에 빨려 들지 마세요.
stages.mechanic: NOT whale-blow, NOT solstice-glider, NOT crane-lift. Coupled: orbit radius vs climb. Dust columns telegraph. Camera behind a microlight.

stages.title: 간헐 얼음
stages.description: 플룸이 솟는 순간에 뛰어 다음 능선으로 건너세요.
stages.mechanic: NOT drum-geyser (no drums), NOT whale-blow. Europa-like ice. Coupled: plume timing vs landing on moving slabs. Camera low over ice.

stages.title: 동굴 측량
stages.description: 줄자와 클리노로 측량하며 배터리와 협착을 관리하세요.
stages.controls: 드래그로 이동, 홀드로 측량, 탭으로 헤드램프
stages.mechanic: NOT echo-sonar (no moth hunting). Coupled: shot quality vs lamp battery vs squeeze. Camera with the surveyor.

stages.title: 코니스 능선
stages.description: 코니스를 탐침한 뒤 안전한 쪽으로 능선을 건너세요.
stages.mechanic: NOT avalanche-sled, NOT ash-ridge. Coupled: probe readings vs weight on the cornice. Distinct from avalanche-probe (that's debris search). Camera on the ridge looking into void.

stages.title: 맹그로브
stages.description: 뿌리를 피해 삿대로 밀고 밀물이 빠지기 전에 나가세요.
stages.mechanic: NOT gondola-pole (not Venice), NOT kelp-gate, NOT lantern-drift. Coupled: pole vs falling tide. Camera through the roots.

stages.title: 카나트
stages.description: 지하 수로가 무너지지 않게 램프를 켜고 토사를 빼세요.
stages.controls: 드래그로 이동, 탭으로 버팀목, 홀드로 토사 제거
stages.mechanic: NOT well-bucket, NOT ice-core-drill. Coupled: shoring vs lamp oil vs collapse. Camera in the tunnel toward the mother well.
